test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is: **provoked**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word 'provoked' means to stimulate or cause a reaction.
 
• In the given sentence, the experts were looking to see what kind of immune response was provoked, which means they were trying to stimulate or cause a reaction in the immune system. 

Therefore, the correct answer is: provoked.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The word 'reduced' means to make something smaller or less in amount. 
 
• The word 'sheltered' means to protect or provide refuge. 
 
• The word 'lessened' means to make something less severe or intense.
